import Mathlib

inductive Node
| mk (is_end : Bool) (children : List (Option Node))
deriving Inhabited

namespace Node

def is_end (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.mk b _ => b

def children (t : Node) : List (Option Node) :=
  match t with
  | Node.mk _ c => c

end Node

-- Helper for enum behavior
def enumerate {α} (l : List α) : List (Nat × α) :=
  (List.range l.length).zip l

-- Using Set theory directly
def view (t : Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  let current : Set (List Int) := if t.is_end then {[]} else ∅
  let child_views : Set (List Int) :=
    let indexed_children := enumerate t.children
    indexed_children.foldr (fun (idx_child : Nat × Option Node) acc =>
      match idx_child.2 with
      | some child =>
        let suffix_set := view child
        let prefixed_set := suffix_set.image (fun suffix => (idx_child.1 : Int) :: suffix)
        acc ∪ prefixed_set
      | none => acc
    ) ∅
  current ∪ child_views
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by sorry

-- Safe list access helper
def list_get_opt {α} (l : List α) (n : Nat) : Option α :=
  if h : n < l.length then some (l.get ⟨n, h⟩) else none

def contains (t : Node) (key : List Int) : Bool :=
  match key with
  | [] => t.is_end
  | c :: cs =>
    let children := t.children
      if c < children.length ∧ c ≥ 0 then
        match list_get_opt children c.toNat with
        | some (some child) => contains child cs
        | _ => false
      else
        false

def is_empty_node (t : Node) : Bool :=
  !t.is_end ∧ t.children.all Option.isNone

def is_valid_key (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ k ∈ key, 0 ≤ k ∧ k < 256

def is_valid_key (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ k ∈ key, 0 ≤ k ∧ k < 256

@[reducible, simp]
def insert_precond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  (match t with
  | some node => well_formed node ∧ !is_empty_node node
  | none => True) ∧
  is_valid_key key -- Added to match Dafny requirement
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def search_precond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  (match t with
  | some node => well_formed node ∧ !is_empty_node node
  | none => True) ∧
  is_valid_key key -- Added to match Dafny
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def childFold (V : Node → Set (List Int)) (P : List (Nat × Option Node)) : Set (List Int) :=
  P.foldr (fun (idx_child : Nat × Option Node) acc =>
    match idx_child.2 with
    | some child =>
      let suffix_set := V child
      let prefixed_set := suffix_set.image (fun suffix => (idx_child.1 : Int) :: suffix)
      acc ∪ prefixed_set
    | none => acc
  ) ∅
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def search (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : search_precond t key) : Bool :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | some node => contains node key
  | none => false
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- View wrapper for Option Node
def view_opt (t : Option Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  match t with
  | some node => view node
  | none => ∅

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def search_postcond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) (result : Bool)
    (_ : search_precond t key) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result = (key ∈ view_opt t)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma childFold_nil (V : Node → Set (List Int)) : childFold V [] = ∅ := rfl

lemma childFold_cons_none (V : Node → Set (List Int)) (j : Nat)
    (ps : List (Nat × Option Node)) :
    childFold V ((j, none) :: ps) = childFold V ps := rfl

lemma childFold_cons_some (V : Node → Set (List Int)) (j : Nat) (ch : Node)
    (ps : List (Nat × Option Node)) :
    childFold V ((j, some ch) :: ps) =
      childFold V ps ∪ ((V ch).image (fun s => (j : Int) :: s)) := rfl

lemma mem_childFold (V : Node → Set (List Int)) (P : List (Nat × Option Node))
    (x : List Int) :
    x ∈ childFold V P ↔
      ∃ (i : Nat) (ch : Node) (s : List Int),
        (i, some ch) ∈ P ∧ s ∈ V ch ∧ x = (i : Int) :: s := by
  induction P with
  | nil =>
    rw [childFold_nil]
    constructor
    · intro h
      simp at h
    · rintro ⟨i, ch, s, hm, -, -⟩
      simp at hm
  | cons p ps ih =>
    obtain ⟨j, oc⟩ := p
    cases oc with
    | none =>
      rw [childFold_cons_none, ih]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨i, ch, s, hm, hs, hx⟩
        exact ⟨i, ch, s, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hm), hs, hx⟩
      · rintro ⟨i, ch, s, hm, hs, hx⟩
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hm with h | h
        · have h3 : (some ch : Option Node) = none := congrArg Prod.snd h
          exact absurd h3 (by simp)
        · exact ⟨i, ch, s, h, hs, hx⟩
    | some ch =>
      rw [childFold_cons_some]
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_image, ih]
      constructor
      · rintro (⟨i, ch', s, hm, hs, hx⟩ | ⟨s, hs, hx⟩)
        · exact ⟨i, ch', s, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hm), hs, hx⟩
        · exact ⟨j, ch, s, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl), hs, hx.symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨i, ch', s, hm, hs, hx⟩
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hm with h | h
        · have h1 : i = j := congrArg Prod.fst h
          have h3 : (some ch' : Option Node) = some ch := congrArg Prod.snd h
          have h2 : ch' = ch := by injection h3
          subst h1
          subst h2
          exact Or.inr ⟨s, hs, hx.symm⟩
        · exact Or.inl ⟨i, ch', s, h, hs, hx⟩

lemma zip_map_succ' {α} (l₁ : List Nat) (l₂ : List α) :
    (l₁.map Nat.succ).zip l₂ = (l₁.zip l₂).map (fun p => (p.1 + 1, p.2)) := by
  induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b bs ih =>
    cases l₂ with
    | nil => simp
    | cons c cs => simp [ih]

lemma enumerate_cons {α} (a : α) (L : List α) :
    enumerate (a :: L) = (0, a) :: (enumerate L).map (fun p => (p.1 + 1, p.2)) := by
  unfold enumerate
  rw [List.length_cons, List.range_succ_eq_map, List.zip_cons_cons, zip_map_succ']

lemma mem_enumerate {α} : ∀ (L : List α) (i : Nat) (a : α),
    ((i, a) ∈ enumerate L ↔ L[i]? = some a) := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil =>
    intro i a
    simp [enumerate]
  | cons b t ih =>
    intro i a
    rw [enumerate_cons]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h1 | h2
      · have hi : i = 0 := congrArg Prod.fst h1
        have ha : a = b := congrArg Prod.snd h1
        subst hi
        subst ha
        simp
      · obtain ⟨p, hp, hpe⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h2
        obtain ⟨j, x⟩ := p
        have hi : j + 1 = i := congrArg Prod.fst hpe
        have ha : x = a := congrArg Prod.snd hpe
        subst ha
        subst hi
        have hx := (ih j x).mp hp
        simpa using hx
    · intro h
      cases i with
      | zero =>
        have hb : b = a := by simpa using h
        subst hb
        exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl)
      | succ n =>
        have h' : t[n]? = some a := by simpa using h
        refine List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr ?_)
        exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(n, a), (ih n a).mpr h', rfl⟩

lemma mem_childFold_enumerate (V : Node → Set (List Int)) (L : List (Option Node))
    (x : List Int) :
    x ∈ childFold V (enumerate L) ↔
      ∃ (i : Nat) (ch : Node) (s : List Int),
        L[i]? = some (some ch) ∧ s ∈ V ch ∧ x = (i : Int) :: s := by
  rw [mem_childFold]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, ch, s, hm, hs, hx⟩
    exact ⟨i, ch, s, (mem_enumerate L i (some ch)).mp hm, hs, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, ch, s, hm, hs, hx⟩
    exact ⟨i, ch, s, (mem_enumerate L i (some ch)).mpr hm, hs, hx⟩

lemma list_get_opt_eq {α} (L : List α) (n : Nat) : list_get_opt L n = L[n]? := by
  unfold list_get_opt
  by_cases h : n < L.length
  · rw [dif_pos h, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h]
    all_goals simp
  · rw [dif_neg h]
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)]

lemma view_eq (t : Node) :
    view t = (if t.is_end then ({[]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅) ∪
      childFold view (enumerate t.children) := by
  conv_lhs => rw [view.eq_def]
  all_goals rfl

lemma contains_nil (t : Node) : contains t [] = t.is_end := rfl

lemma contains_cons (t : Node) (c : Int) (cs : List Int) :
    contains t (c :: cs) =
      (if c < (t.children.length : Int) ∧ c ≥ 0 then
        (match list_get_opt t.children c.toNat with
         | some (some child) => contains child cs
         | _ => false)
      else false) := rfl

lemma contains_iff (key : List Int) : ∀ (t : Node), (key ∈ view t ↔ contains t key = true) := by
  induction key with
  | nil =>
    intro t
    rw [view_eq, Set.mem_union, contains_nil]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rcases h with h1 | h2
      · by_cases he : t.is_end = true
        · exact he
        · simp [he] at h1
      · rw [mem_childFold_enumerate] at h2
        obtain ⟨i, ch, s, -, -, hx⟩ := h2
        exact absurd hx (by simp)
    · intro h
      refine Or.inl ?_
      simp [h]
  | cons c cs ih =>
    intro t
    rw [view_eq, Set.mem_union, contains_cons]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rcases h with h1 | h2
      · exfalso
        by_cases he : t.is_end = true <;> simp [he] at h1
      · rw [mem_childFold_enumerate] at h2
        obtain ⟨i, ch, s, hmem, hs, hx⟩ := h2
        obtain ⟨hci, hcs⟩ : c = (i : Int) ∧ cs = s := by
          injection hx with ha hb
          exact ⟨ha, hb⟩
        have hs' : cs ∈ view ch := by rw [hcs]; exact hs
        have hi : i < t.children.length := by
          by_contra hcon
          push_neg at hcon
          rw [List.getElem?_eq_none hcon] at hmem
          simp at hmem
        rw [hci]
        have hcond : ((i : Int) < (t.children.length : Int) ∧ (i : Int) ≥ 0) := by
          refine ⟨?_, by simp⟩
          exact_mod_cast hi
        rw [if_pos hcond]
        have hget : list_get_opt t.children ((i : Int)).toNat = some (some ch) := by
          rw [list_get_opt_eq]
          simpa using hmem
        rw [hget]
        exact (ih ch).mp hs'
    · intro h
      by_cases hcond : (c < (t.children.length : Int) ∧ c ≥ 0)
      · rw [if_pos hcond, list_get_opt_eq] at h
        cases hget : t.children[c.toNat]? with
        | none =>
          rw [hget] at h
          simp at h
        | some oc =>
          cases oc with
          | none =>
            rw [hget] at h
            simp at h
          | some child =>
            rw [hget] at h
            have h' : contains child cs = true := h
            have hnn : (0 : Int) ≤ c := by
              have h2 := hcond.2
              omega
            refine Or.inr ?_
            rw [mem_childFold_enumerate]
            refine ⟨c.toNat, child, cs, hget, (ih child).mpr h', ?_⟩
            rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnn]
      · rw [if_neg hcond] at h
        simp at h
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem search_postcond_satisfied (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : search_precond t key) :
    search_postcond t key (search t key h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases t with
  | none =>
    simp only [search_postcond, search, view_opt]
    simp
  | some node =>
    simp only [search_postcond, search, view_opt]
    simp [contains_iff key node]
  -- !benchmark @end proof
